newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait airline staff halt strike - news agency.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait airline staff halt strike - news agency.

text.p: Pilots and engineers at Kuwait Airways Corp agreed on Wednesday to halt a strike to press for better pay and benefits, the official Kuwaiti news agency KUNA said.
"The Kuwait Aircraft Engineers and Pilots Association has decided as of 1900 local time (1600 GMT) to end protest measures which started with a full strike (on Tuesday)," it said.
It gave no further details and did not say if the strikers' demands had been met.
Tuesday's one-day protest halted all operations by the national carrier from the Gulf Arab state.
Libya, which is under a U.N. air embargo, offered Libyan pilots to Kuwait Airways to try to beat the strike, a local newspaper reported earlier in the day.
Association members agreed on Monday to hold a full strike every Tuesday. Their protest plans also included delaying all of the airline's outbound flights by one hour during the week.

They said said the protest was due to the "failure of negotiations and prolonged deliberations by government committees which have lasted for more than a year without reaching an acceptable settlement".
The union demanded higher salaries and allowances and the restoration of certain benefits.
The association in November agreed to postpone a flight delay protest after talks with the country's crown prince and prime minister, Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah.
